verdict.rationale: Radar documents custom Dashboard rules that request 3DS, block, or send payments to review, plus allow lists and attribute-based rules. Risk settings also adjust protection thresholds to the business's tolerance, so the core action mapping and threshold tuning are present. No item explicitly shows rules keyed to numeric risk-score ranges, and a community report says allow rules are not enabled by default for newer businesses and require contacting support. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mapping risk-score ranges to each action, evidence of fine-grained custom score cutoffs beyond preset risk settings, default self-serve allow rules, independent hands-on corroboration of threshold tuning.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map score ranges to actions — allow, review, block, step-up 3DS — and tune thresholds to my own risk appetite instead of a fixed cutoff
